slope_gate_design.rationale: Tnua 0.31 clears standing_on above max_slope; that classification is the mechanism check, not success. A fall fails. Climb, vertical speed, oscillation and recovery bounds are unchanged.
slope_gate_design.steep_ground_controller_policy: Steep ground acts as a wall: uphill input is removed, Tnua runs SenseOnly unless input leads downhill, and a character blocked after walkable support holds its height (Y locked, vertical velocity zeroed) until downhill input or walkable ground. Vertical speed and oscillation while held are zero by this policy, not by settling physics.
slope_gate_design.non_blocking_diagnostics: steep_rejection_diagnostic_* repeat the gate at 17-30 degrees and 25-100% approach speed; they are reported but do not fail the suite.

authored_lateral_push_gate.station_rule: four room-edge midpoints, one per authored boundary
authored_lateral_push_gate.target_edges: west, east, south and north authored room boundaries
authored_lateral_push_gate.lateral_offset_definition: absolute capsule-center displacement from each room-edge station until the named authored boundary arrests movement
authored_lateral_push_gate.boundary_contact_record_fields: tick, expected boundary side and player position
authored_lateral_push_gate.bottom_rise_definition: maximum capsule-bottom Y minus its initial capsule-bottom Y over input and release
authored_lateral_push_gate.final_rest_definition: last 10 release ticks satisfy speed and position-radius bounds
authored_lateral_push_gate.open_ledge_negative_control: open_ledge_0_8m unchanged and must reach SafetyNet
